brief: 60-seat Indian restaurant in Bangalore, 80 sqm total. Front dining area with 10 tables of 4 each. Bar/billing counter near entry with 2 bar stools. Kitchen partition at back (not modeling kitchen interior). Restrooms partition near kitchen. Windows along south wall, main door at front. Pendant lights over each table, ambient wall sconces. 3.2m ceiling. Mosaic tile floor, sheesham wood furniture.
